blurb: The Greenwood Lake Experience offers high energy, full service boat charters on Greenwood Lake. Guests can customize their event with boats, water activities, creative decorations, chef-curated meals, professional bartenders, and personalized water sports. They cater to a variety of events including birthdays, anniversaries, and team outings, with options to tie boats together for large gatherings.
